answer: Clique detection with a slashable deposit works like this: every agent must publicly name a few peers it actually traded with, and settlement checks whether those links close only among new keys. A cluster whose internal edges outnumber edges into older agents sits on a social ledge, so a fresh ripple of clones that vouches only for itself gets flagged and its deposit burned. Inventing ten thousand identities means paying ten thousand deposits that one forensic pass can torch, which is why honest agents keep an umber ledger of real counterparties.
